en.text: The LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the Tent of Meeting, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

footnotes.text: 1:1 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה*”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

zhSimplified.text: 以色列人出埃及地后，第二年二月初一日，耶和华在西奈的旷野、会幕中晓谕摩西说：

zhTraditional.text: 以色列人出埃及地後，第二年二月初一日，耶和華在西奈的曠野、會幕中曉諭摩西說：

en.text: “Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, every male, one by one,

zhSimplified.text: 「你要按以色列全会众的家室、宗族、人名的数目计算所有的男丁。

zhTraditional.text: 「你要按以色列全會眾的家室、宗族、人名的數目計算所有的男丁。

en.text: from twenty years old and upward, all who are able to go out to war in Israel. You and Aaron shall count them by their divisions.

zhSimplified.text: 凡以色列中，从二十岁以外，能出去打仗的，你和亚伦要照他们的军队数点。

zhTraditional.text: 凡以色列中，從二十歲以外，能出去打仗的，你和亞倫要照他們的軍隊數點。

en.text: With you there shall be a man of every tribe, each one head of his fathers’ house.

zhSimplified.text: 每支派中必有一人作本支派的族长，帮助你们。

zhTraditional.text: 每支派中必有一人作本支派的族長，幫助你們。

en.text: These are the names of the men who shall stand with you: Of Reuben: Elizur the son of Shedeur.

zhSimplified.text: 他们的名字：属吕便的，有示丢珥的儿子以利蓿；

zhTraditional.text: 他們的名字：屬呂便的，有示丟珥的兒子以利蓿；

en.text: Of Simeon: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

zhSimplified.text: 属西缅的，有苏利沙代的儿子示路蔑；

zhTraditional.text: 屬西緬的，有蘇利沙代的兒子示路蔑；

en.text: Of Judah: Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

zhSimplified.text: 属犹大的，有亚米拿达的儿子拿顺；

zhTraditional.text: 屬猶大的，有亞米拿達的兒子拿順；

en.text: Of Issachar: Nethanel the son of Zuar.

zhSimplified.text: 属以萨迦的，有苏押的儿子拿坦业；

zhTraditional.text: 屬以薩迦的，有蘇押的兒子拿坦業；

en.text: Of Zebulun: Eliab the son of Helon.

zhSimplified.text: 属西布伦的，有希伦的儿子以利押；

zhTraditional.text: 屬西布倫的，有希倫的兒子以利押；

en.text: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim: Elishama the son of Ammihud; of Manasseh: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

zhSimplified.text: 约瑟子孙、属以法莲的，有亚米忽的儿子以利沙玛；属玛拿西的，有比大蓿的儿子迦玛列；

zhTraditional.text: 約瑟子孫、屬以法蓮的，有亞米忽的兒子以利沙瑪；屬瑪拿西的，有比大蓿的兒子迦瑪列；

en.text: Of Benjamin: Abidan the son of Gideoni.

zhSimplified.text: 属便雅悯的，有基多尼的儿子亚比但；

zhTraditional.text: 屬便雅憫的，有基多尼的兒子亞比但；

en.text: Of Dan: Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

zhSimplified.text: 属但的，有亚米沙代的儿子亚希以谢；

zhTraditional.text: 屬但的，有亞米沙代的兒子亞希以謝；

en.text: Of Asher: Pagiel the son of Ochran.

zhSimplified.text: 属亚设的，有俄兰的儿子帕结；

zhTraditional.text: 屬亞設的，有俄蘭的兒子帕結；

en.text: Of Gad: Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

zhSimplified.text: 属迦得的，有丢珥的儿子以利雅萨；

zhTraditional.text: 屬迦得的，有丟珥的兒子以利雅薩；

en.text: Of Naphtali: Ahira the son of Enan.”

zhSimplified.text: 属拿弗他利的，有以南的儿子亚希拉。

zhTraditional.text: 屬拿弗他利的，有以南的兒子亞希拉。

en.text: These are those who were called of the congregation, the princes of the tribes of their fathers; they were the heads of the thousands of Israel.

zhSimplified.text: 这都是从会中选召的，各作本支派的首领，都是以色列军中的统领。」

zhTraditional.text: 這都是從會中選召的，各作本支派的首領，都是以色列軍中的統領。」

en.text: Moses and Aaron took these men who are mentioned by name.

zhSimplified.text: 于是，摩西、亚伦带着这些按名指定的人，

zhTraditional.text: 於是，摩西、亞倫帶着這些按名指定的人，

en.text: They assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month; and they declared their ancestry by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, one by one.

zhSimplified.text: 当二月初一日招聚全会众。会众就照他们的家室、宗族、人名的数目，从二十岁以外的，都述说自己的家谱。

zhTraditional.text: 當二月初一日招聚全會眾。會眾就照他們的家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外的，都述說自己的家譜。

en.text: As the LORD commanded Moses, so he counted them in the wilderness of Sinai.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华怎样吩咐摩西，他就怎样在西奈的旷野数点他们。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華怎樣吩咐摩西，他就怎樣在西奈的曠野數點他們。

en.text: The children of Reuben, Israel’s firstborn, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, one by one, every male from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

zhSimplified.text: 以色列的长子，吕便子孙的后代，照着家室、宗族、人名的数目，从二十岁以外，凡能出去打仗、被数的男丁，共有四万六千五百名。

zhTraditional.text: 以色列的長子，呂便子孫的後代，照着家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的男丁，共有四萬六千五百名。

en.text: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Reuben, were forty-six thousand five hundred.

Of the children of Simeon, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, those who were counted of it, according to the number of the names, one by one, every male from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

zhSimplified.text: 西缅子孙的后代，照着家室、宗族、人名的数目，从二十岁以外，凡能出去打仗、被数的男丁，共有五万九千三百名。

zhTraditional.text: 西緬子孫的後代，照着家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的男丁，共有五萬九千三百名。

en.text: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Simeon, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.
Of the children of Gad, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

zhSimplified.text: 迦得子孙的后代，照着家室、宗族、人名的数目，从二十岁以外，凡能出去打仗、被数的，共有四万五千六百五十名。

zhTraditional.text: 迦得子孫的後代，照着家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的，共有四萬五千六百五十名。

en.text: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Gad, were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.
Of the children of Judah, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

zhSimplified.text: 犹大子孙的后代，照着家室、宗族、人名的数目，从二十岁以外，凡能出去打仗、被数的，共有七万四千六百名。

zhTraditional.text: 猶大子孫的後代，照着家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的，共有七萬四千六百名。

en.text: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Judah, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.

Of the children of Issachar, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

zhSimplified.text: 以萨迦子孙的后代，照着家室、宗族、人名的数目，从二十岁以外，凡能出去打仗、被数的，共有五万四千四百名。

zhTraditional.text: 以薩迦子孫的後代，照着家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的，共有五萬四千四百名。

en.text: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Issachar, were fifty-four thousand four hundred.
Of the children of Zebulun, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

zhSimplified.text: 西布伦子孙的后代，照着家室、宗族、人名的数目，从二十岁以外，凡能出去打仗、被数的，共有五万七千四百名。

zhTraditional.text: 西布倫子孫的後代，照着家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的，共有五萬七千四百名。

en.text: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Zebulun, were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.

Of the children of Joseph: of the children of Ephraim, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

zhSimplified.text: 约瑟子孙属以法莲子孙的后代，照着家室、宗族、人名的数目，从二十岁以外，凡能出去打仗、被数的，共有四万零五百名。

zhTraditional.text: 約瑟子孫屬以法蓮子孫的後代，照着家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的，共有四萬零五百名。

en.text: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Ephraim, were forty thousand five hundred.

Of the children of Manasseh, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

zhSimplified.text: 玛拿西子孙的后代，照着家室、宗族、人名的数目，从二十岁以外，凡能出去打仗、被数的，共有三万二千二百名。

zhTraditional.text: 瑪拿西子孫的後代，照着家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的，共有三萬二千二百名。

en.text: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.

Of the children of Benjamin, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

zhSimplified.text: 便雅悯子孙的后代，照着家室、宗族、人名的数目，从二十岁以外，凡能出去打仗、被数的，共有三万五千四百名。

zhTraditional.text: 便雅憫子孫的後代，照着家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的，共有三萬五千四百名。

en.text: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Benjamin, were thirty-five thousand four hundred.
Of the children of Dan, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

zhSimplified.text: 但子孙的后代，照着家室、宗族、人名的数目，从二十岁以外，凡能出去打仗、被数的，共有六万二千七百名。

zhTraditional.text: 但子孫的後代，照着家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的，共有六萬二千七百名。

en.text: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Dan, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
Of the children of Asher, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

zhSimplified.text: 亚设子孙的后代，照着家室、宗族、人名的数目，从二十岁以外，凡能出去打仗、被数的，共有四万一千五百名。

zhTraditional.text: 亞設子孫的後代，照着家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的，共有四萬一千五百名。

en.text: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Asher, were forty-one thousand five hundred.

Of the children of Naphtali, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

zhSimplified.text: 拿弗他利子孙的后代，照着家室、宗族、人名的数目，从二十岁以外，凡能出去打仗、被数的，共有五万三千四百名。

zhTraditional.text: 拿弗他利子孫的後代，照着家室、宗族、人名的數目，從二十歲以外，凡能出去打仗、被數的，共有五萬三千四百名。

en.text: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.
These are those who were counted, whom Moses and Aaron counted, and the twelve men who were princes of Israel, each one for his fathers’ house.

zhSimplified.text: 这些就是被数点的，是摩西、亚伦，和以色列中十二个首领所数点的；这十二个人各作各宗族的代表。

zhTraditional.text: 這些就是被數點的，是摩西、亞倫，和以色列中十二個首領所數點的；這十二個人各作各宗族的代表。

en.text: So all those who were counted of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war in Israel—

zhSimplified.text: 这样，凡以色列人中被数的，照着宗族，从二十岁以外，能出去打仗、被数的，共有六十万零三千五百五十名。

zhTraditional.text: 這樣，凡以色列人中被數的，照着宗族，從二十歲以外，能出去打仗、被數的，共有六十萬零三千五百五十名。

en.text: all those who were counted were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.
But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not counted among them.

zhSimplified.text: 利未人却没有按着支派数在其中，

zhTraditional.text: 利未人卻沒有按着支派數在其中，

en.text: For the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 因为耶和华晓谕摩西说：

zhTraditional.text: 因為耶和華曉諭摩西說：

en.text: “Only the tribe of Levi you shall not count, neither shall you take a census of them among the children of Israel;

zhSimplified.text: 「惟独利未支派你不可数点，也不可在以色列人中计算他们的总数。

zhTraditional.text: 「惟獨利未支派你不可數點，也不可在以色列人中計算他們的總數。

en.text: but appoint the Levites over the Tabernacle of the Testimony, and over all its furnishings, and over all that belongs to it. They shall carry the tabernacle and all its furnishings; and they shall take care of it, and shall encamp around it.

zhSimplified.text: 只要派利未人管法柜的帐幕和其中的器具，并属乎帐幕的；他们要抬帐幕和其中的器具，并要办理帐幕的事，在帐幕的四围安营。

zhTraditional.text: 只要派利未人管法櫃的帳幕和其中的器具，並屬乎帳幕的；他們要抬帳幕和其中的器具，並要辦理帳幕的事，在帳幕的四圍安營。

en.text: When the tabernacle is to move, the Levites shall take it down; and when the tabernacle is to be set up, the Levites shall set it up. The stranger who comes near shall be put to death.

zhSimplified.text: 帐幕将往前行的时候，利未人要拆卸；将支搭的时候，利未人要竖起。近前来的外人必被治死。

zhTraditional.text: 帳幕將往前行的時候，利未人要拆卸；將支搭的時候，利未人要豎起。近前來的外人必被治死。

en.text: The children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, according to their divisions.

zhSimplified.text: 以色列人支搭帐棚，要照他们的军队，各归本营，各归本纛。

zhTraditional.text: 以色列人支搭帳棚，要照他們的軍隊，各歸本營，各歸本纛。

en.text: But the Levites shall encamp around the Tabernacle of the Testimony, that there may be no wrath on the congregation of the children of Israel. The Levites shall be responsible for the Tabernacle of the Testimony.”

zhSimplified.text: 但利未人要在法柜帐幕的四围安营，免得忿怒临到以色列会众；利未人并要谨守法柜的帐幕。」

zhTraditional.text: 但利未人要在法櫃帳幕的四圍安營，免得忿怒臨到以色列會眾；利未人並要謹守法櫃的帳幕。」

en.text: Thus the children of Israel did. According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so they did.

zhSimplified.text: 以色列人就这样行。凡耶和华所吩咐摩西的，他们就照样行了。

zhTraditional.text: 以色列人就這樣行。凡耶和華所吩咐摩西的，他們就照樣行了。
